resources.string: Runs the built-in file sync engine. It keeps the workspace files of the user in sync with the computers of the same user, so that the phone gets new questions and gates in a few seconds.
Shows that the sync engine runs.
AW · sync failed, it tries again
AW · sync is off: the engine is not installed
Battery mode \"Restricted\": sync stops in Doze. Tap to open the app settings and select \"Unrestricted\" or \"Optimized\".
